name: Nimble FIngers
description: This attack causes no damage. When this attack hits an enemy Leader model, your opponent must discard one Command Card of their choice.

name: Balefire
description: This weapon’s attack rolls are boosted against living models.

name: Spirit Eater
description: This model can reave fury points from enemy warbeasts destroyed by this weapon. Other models cannot reave fury points from enemy warbeasts destroyed by this weapon.

name: •Blind
description: A model is hit by this attack suffers Blind for one round. (A model suffering Blind cannot make ranged or arcane attacks, suffers –4 MAT and DEF, and cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks. It must forfeit either its Normal Movement or Combat Action during its next activation. Blind can be shaken.)

name: •Shadow Bind
description: A model hit by this weapon suffers Shadow Bind for one round. (A model suffering Shadow Bind suffers –3 DEF and cannot advance for one round. Shadow Bind can be shaken.)

name: •Burning Flames
description: If this attack directly hits, models within 2" of the model directly hit suffer the Fire continuous effect.

name: Soul Fired [2]
description: This model can spend soul tokens to make up to 2 additional ranged attacks with this weapon during its Combat Action. It can make one additional attack for each soul token spent.

name: •Blood Shadow
description: If this attack boxes a living or undead model, this model can gain Incorporeal for one round.

name: •Death Strike
description: If this attack destroys a living or undead model, after resolving the attack choose a model within 4" of this model. The chosen model suffers a POW 10 damage roll

name: •Feedback
description: When this weapon damages a warjack that is part of a battlegroup, the warjack’s controller suffers 1 damage point.

name: Pinning Fire
description: When an enemy warrior model is hit by this weapon, after the attack is resolved the enemy model becomes knocked down and can be pushed 2" directly away from the attacking model.

name: Critical Heart Seeker
description: On a critical hit, gain an additional die on this weapon’s damage rolls against the target directly hit. Discard the lowest die in each roll.

name: Jaws of Urcaen
description: If this attack’s original target is an enemy model and that model is boxed by this attack, you can make a SP 6 attack using the boxed model as the attack’s point of origin. Models hit suffer a POW 14 magical damage roll. Models boxed by an attack made with this weapon are removed from play.

name: Soul Fired [1]
description: This model can spend 1 soul token to make one additional ranged attack with this weapon during its Combat Action.

name: Clipped Wings
description: A model with Flight hit by this weapon suffers -2 SPD for one round.

name: Life Stealer
description: When an attack with this weapon destroys an enemy model, immediately after the attack is resolved a friendly living Faction model currently within 10" of this model can remove d3 damage points.

name: Transfiguration
description: Models destroyed by this weapon are removed from play. When an attack from this weapon destroys one or more enemy models, return one destroyed Grunt to a friendly Faction unit within 8" of this model. The Grunt returns with one unmarked damage box. Place the Grunt within 2" of another model in that unit. The returned Grunt must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Action the turn it is put into play.

name: Into the Light
description: If this attack hits an enemy model with an equal or smaller base, immediately after the attack is resolved the enemy model can be pushed directly towards this model until it contacts this model. During this push, the enemy model can move through obstacles or obstructions if the push is enough to move completely past.

name: Electrocutioner
description: A model directly hit by this attack suffers a cumulative –1 DEF for one turn unless it has Resistance: Electricity. When a model without Resistance: Electricity is directly hit with three or more Electrocutioner attacks in the same turn, it becomes stationary for one round.

name: Critical Brain Damage
description: On a critical hit, a model damaged by an attack with this weapon cannot cast spells for one round.

name: Power Multiplier
description: Models in this unit gain a +1 cumulative bonus to ranged attack and ranged attack damage rolls for each other model in this unit that has directly hit an enemy model with a ranged attack this activation.

name: Power Loader [1]
description: This model can spend 1 power token to make one additional ranged attack with this weapon during its Combat Action.

name: Electrical Current
description: If this attack hits a model during this unit’s activation, ranged attacks against that model made by models in this unit later this activation automatically hit.

name: Triangulation
description: This model gains a cumulative +1 bonus to its Storm Strike attack and damage rolls for each other friendly Stormsmith Stormcaller model within 10" of it, up to a bonus of +2.

name: Combo Pitch (★Attack)
description: On a hit against a model with an equal or smaller base, the model hit is thrown d6" directly away from this model. When resolving damage for this attack, the model hit suffers a damage roll with POW equal to the POW of this weapon. The POW of collateral damage is equal to the POW of this weapon.

name: Chain Attack: Shifter
description: If this model hits the same model with both its initial attacks with this weapon, after resolving the attacks it can immediately use Shifter. (Place this model B2B with the enemy hit.)

name: Soul Taker: Soul Thief
description: This model can gain soul tokens. When this model destroys a living enemy model with an attack with this weapon, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. When this model replenishes its focus during your next Control Phase, replace each soul token on it with 1 focus point.

name: Death Strike
description: If this attack destroys a living or undead model, after resolving the attack choose a model within 4" of this model. The chosen model suffers a POW 10 damage roll.

name: Reel In
description: When this attack hits an enemy model, immediately after the attack is resolved place this model B2B with the enemy model.

name: Chain Attack: Mage Storm
description: If this model hits the same model with both its initial attacks with this weapon, you can choose to center a cloud effect template on the model hit. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. A model entering or ending its activation in the template suffers a POW 12 fire damage roll.

name: Petrified
description: A living warrior model hit by this attack becomes stationary for one round.

name: Greed Bound
description: When this model destroys a living enemy warrior model with this weapon, after the attack is resolved you can return one destroyed model in this unit to play. Place the returned model completely within 3" of this model. The returned model cannot activate the turn it returns to play. The destroyed model is removed from play.

name: •Canister Shot
description: This weapon’s base stats become RNG SP 10, AOE –

name: •Cannonball
description: This weapon’s base stats become RNG 20. A model hit is slammed d6" directly away from this model. The POW of collateral damage is equal to the POW of this attack.

name: •Incendiary Shot
description: This weapon’s base stats become RNG 16, AOE 4, and POW 14/7 for this attack. This attack causes fire damage and models hit suffer the Fire continuous effect.

name: Guided
description: Attacks made with this weapon automatically hit.

name: •Electro Blast
description: This attack causes electrical damage. A warjack directly hit by this attack suffers Disruption.

name: Arcane Interference
description: Upkeep spells and animi on a model directly hit with this weapon expire. A warjack directly hit with this weapon suffers Disruption.

name: Firing Formulae
description: When this model makes a ranged attack with this weapon during its activation, determine the position of the Permutation Servitors this model put into play. For each B2B with it, this model gains an additional die on its attack rolls. For each within 1" of it, but not B2B with it, this model gains an additional die on its damage rolls.

name: Sentry Fire
description: Once per turn, when an enemy model advances into and ends its movement or is placed within 8" of this model, this model can immediately make one basic ranged attack targeting that model.

name: Telekinetic Slam
description: On a direct hit, target model is slammed d6" in a direction of your choice. Collateral damage is resolved at POW of this weapon.

name: Thresher (★Attack)
description: This model makes one melee attack with this weapon against each model in its LOS that is in this weapon’s melee range, regardless of whether that model is a friendly model or an enemy model. Thresher attacks are simultaneous.

name: Death Boon
description: When this model destroys an enemy warrior model with an attack with this weapon, immediately after the attack is resolved one model in this model’s battlegroup currently in its control range can gain 1 focus or fury point.

name: •Reel In
description: When this attack hits an enemy model, immediately after the attack is resolved place this model B2B with the enemy model.

name: Spellbound
description: This model can channel spells through a model hit by an attack made with this weapon this turn.

name: Fast Reload
description: While this model is within 1" of the Grunt, this weapon gains +1 ROF.

name: •Acid Bath
description: On a direct hit, this weapon becomes AOE 2, POW 10/5. Models hit suffer the corrosion continuous effect.

name: •Erosion
description: This model gains an additional die on this weapon’s damage rolls against construct models.

name: Death Toll [Holy Zealot]
description: When this weapon boxes a living enemy warrior model, remove that model from play and return one Grunt to a friendly Holy Zealot unit within 8" of this model. Place the Grunt within 2" of another model in that unit. The Grunt must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Action the turn it is put into play.

name: •Sky Rumbler
description: On a direct hit, the model hit and models within 5" of it lose Flight for one round.

name: Servitor Launch
description: When this model directly hits an enemy model with this weapon, you can immediately place one Accretion Servitor, Attunement Servitor, Elimination Servitor, or Reflex Servitor solo into play anywhere completely within 2" of the enemy model hit. The servitor must forfeit its Combat Action the turn it is put into play.

name: Pitch (★Attack)
description: On a hit against a model with an equal or smaller base, the model hit is thrown d6" directly away from this model. The POW of collateral damage is equal to the POW of this attack.

name: Black Mark
description: When this model destroys a living non-soulless enemy model with an attack with this weapon, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token.

name: Attack Type
description:
Each time this weapon is used to make an attack, choose one of the following special rules:

• Beat Back - Immediately after a basic attack with this weapon is resolved during this model’s Combat Action, the enemy model hit can be pushed 1" directly away from the attacking model. After the enemy model is pushed, the attacking model can advance up to 1" directly toward it.

• Brutal Damage - On a direct hit, gain an additional die on this weapon’s damage rolls against the target directly hit.

• Witch Mark - If this attack directly hits an enemy model during this model’s activation, until the end of that activation this model can target and automatically hit that enemy model with spells, ignoring RNG and LOS.

name: Critical Ricochet
description: When this model critically hits an enemy model with an attack with this weapon, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can make another ranged attack with this weapon targeting another model within 4" of the model originally hit, ignoring LOS and this weapon’s RNG. Attacks gained from Ricochet cannot generate additional attacks from Ricochet.

name: Afflicter
description: The model hit suffers the Torment continuous effect.

name: Blood Boon
description: Once per activation, immediately after resolving an attack in which it destroyed an enemy model with this weapon, this model can cast a spell without spending focus or fury points.

name: Brutal Charge
description: This model gains +2 to charge attack damage rolls with this weapon.

name: Attack Type
description:
Each time this weapon is used to make an attack, choose one of the following special rules:

• Thunderbolt - Enemy models hit are pushed d3" directly away from the attacking model. On a critical hit, the enemy model becomes knocked down after being pushed.

• Afflicter - The model hit suffers the Torment continuous effect.

• Huntsman’s Lure - Friendly Faction warbeasts gain +2 SPD when charging a model hit by this attack. Huntsman’s Lure lasts for one turn.

name: Attack Type
description:
Each time this weapon is used to make an attack, choose one of the following special rules:

• Blade - This weapon becomes RNG 2, POW 12 for this attack. If this attack destroys an enemy model, a friendly Eldritch Leader model gains one hunger point.

• Chain - This attack gains Decapitation. (Damage from an attack with Decapitation that exceeds the ARM of the model hit is doubled. A model disabled by the attack cannot make a tough roll.)

name: Attack Type
description:
Each time this weapon is used to make an attack, choose one of the following special rules:

• Beat Back - Immediately after a basic attack with this weapon is resolved during this model’s Combat Action, the enemy model hit can be pushed 1" directly away from the attacking model. After the enemy model is pushed, the attacking model can advance up to 1" directly toward it.

• Brutal Damage - On a direct hit, gain an additional die on this weapon’s damage rolls against the target directly hit.

name: Critical Slow
description: A living model critically hit by this weapon has its base DEF reduced to 5. Slow lasts for one round.

name: Lure
description: An enemy non-Leader model hit by this attack can be placed completely within 1" of its current location.

name: Critical Afflicter
description: On a critical hit, the model hit suffers the Torment continuous effect.

name: Flak Munitions
description: Attacks made with this weapon ignore Flying High and Warping Winds special rules.
